pages.text: $(bold)Cursed Speech$(): words are power — speak, and they come true.$(br2)$(bold)Cursed Speech structure$(): every incantation is built from six parts — "$(l)Invocation$(), $(l)Honorific + Designation$(), $(l)Supplication + Core Word$(), $(l)Closing Words$()!"$(br2)$(bold)Forward (Technique Key C)$(): chant the current incantation. Chanting requires a cast bar (its length grows with the incantation's rarity), slows your movement while it lasts, and being hit interrupts it without refunding cursed energy; once released, backlash is settled from the target's current health and your own cursed energy output / affinity, deducted from your own health (the higher the target's health, the stronger the backlash — while output and affinity resist it and the Closing Words trim it down).$(br2)$(bold)Curse Power$(): determined by your $(l)curse output$() and $(l)curse affinity$() — power = 1 + (output level + affinity/10)/10. It scales both the effect (healing, duration, damage) and the $(l)area of effect$(): centered on your aim point (or on yourself if nothing is aimed at), with a radius of 6 blocks x power, affecting $(l)every non-ally living entity$() inside; the nearest one is the primary target (backlash is settled from the highest health ratio in the area).$(br2)$(bold)Cursed Tempo$(): a new curse core upgrade, up to level 5, cutting chant time down to 0.17x (see the "Cursed Tempo" entry).

$(bold)Reversal (Reversal Key F)$(): opens the Cursed Speech editor — pick one learned word for each of the six segments.$(br2)$(bold)Learning words$(): opening various loot chests may grant you "Ancient Cursed Technique Fragments"; right-click to learn them (they are not consumed — if you have already learned one, you will be told so).$(br2)$(bold)Word effects$():$(li)Invocation → cursed energy cost (the rarer the word, the lower the cost)$(li)Honorific → effect power ("foolish" < ... < "unnameable")$(li)Supplication → duration ("I command you" < ... < "I beseech you")$(li)Closing Words → backlash reduction ("a reward" < ... < "give everything")$(li)Designation → bonus effect (Nyarlathotep / Shub-Niggurath / Yog-Sothoth only pair with the "unnameable" honorific)$(li)Core Word → the main effect (Heal / Weakness / Restrain / Ignite / Lightning / Launch...)
